initialWorkflowResults.name: PocketBase backend CI
initialWorkflowResults.failure: All 17 reported failures were EACCES cleanup errors from root-owned files/directories in Linux Docker bind-mounted temporary databases. Image/restore step was skipped after the failing test step.

remediation.scope: Only writable test containers now use Node process.getuid()/process.getgid(). Cleanup failures and all business/safety assertions remain strict. Production image and frozen release package were unchanged.

nativeLinuxPermissionControl.filesystem: Docker named volume; real PocketBase migration

remediation.linuxFullSuiteVerification: GitHub Actions backend CI #19 on ubuntu-latest

finalBackendVerification.skippedTest: PocketBase JSVM signs an AGC PS256 JWT using the image's OpenSSL
finalBackendVerification.skippedReason: PB_PUSH_VALIDATE_OPENSSL was not set to 1; this opt-in test generates a synthetic RSA key. It is not a real Huawei delivery test.
finalBackendVerification.imageAndRestoreRehearsal: passed: pinned runtime version, empty-database migration, authenticated hooks, restart and offline database-copy restore
